subject: Shiny runs on localhost but gives errors on the Beta Server

messages.author: 5693037a2015a822
messages.subject: Shiny runs on localhost but gives errors on the Beta Server
parts:
Hello
My code works on localhost  (ui.R and server.R work and give results, both tabular and graphical). However, when using the free Beta Server account,
I get the following error(s):

The application unexpectedly exited.
Diagnostic Information has been dumped to the Javascript Console.

When I look at the Javascript Console I see the following message:

cdn.optimizely.com : server does not support RFC 5746, see CVE-2009-3555


If you have any suggestions to overcome this error, it will be of immense help. I was hoping to do a demo on Monday, using this shiny app.
It does work very well on my local machine (localhost:), but it would be wonderful if the app could be accessed on the web.

Thanks in advance.

Best regards
blasiyer
